title: Review a change before I merge
summary: Follow-up questions that appear only when they apply, a diff to read, a star rating, a table of requested changes, and time fields.
description: I fixed the retry loop in the uploader. Read the diff, give a verdict, and the form asks only what that verdict needs: requested changes if you approve with changes, a reason if you reject, a merge window if it goes ahead.

fields.label: uploader/retry.go
Why exponential backoff, and why only some errors retry
fields.text:
A fixed one-second sleep hammered a struggling server five times in five seconds, and it retried **400s**, which can never succeed.

- 250 ms, 500 ms, 1 s, 2 s, 4 s: about 8 s in total, the same as before.
- `retryable` is true for network errors, 429 and 5xx only.
- A cancelled context now stops the loop at once.

options.label: Approve with changes
options.description: Merge once the points below are done

fields.label: Requested changes
fields.help: One row per point. Only asked because you approve with changes.

fields.label: What would make you change your mind?
fields.help: Optional when you approve with changes, required when you reject.
